```yaml
name: E2E Docs & Sandbox Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'feat/**'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read
  checks: write

jobs:
  e2e-tests:
    name: Run E2E Tests (LocalSandbox & Workspace)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [20, 22]
      fail-fast: false

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run TypeScript type check
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run LocalSandbox E2E Tests
        # Specifically targets the sandbox tests which include the new symlink mount tests
        run: npm test -- --testPathPattern="local-sandbox" --verbose

      - name: Run Workspace & LocalFilesystem E2E Tests
        # Targets workspace tests which include contained:false and getMountConfig tests
        run: npm test -- --testPathPattern="workspace|local-filesystem" --verbose

      - name: Upload Test Results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results-node-${{ matrix.node-version }}
          path: |
            coverage/
            test-results/
          retention-days: 5
```
